title: 斜張索雨風振動抑制
titleEn: Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables
summary: 雨風振動是斜張索在中等風速與降雨同時出現時發生的大振幅振動，1980 年代在日本名港西大橋首次被系統記錄，之後在諾曼第大橋與伊拉斯謨大橋等通車初期都曾出現。本課從上緣水線的氣動機制、史庫頓數門檻、HDPE 套管的螺旋凸肋，到外置與內置阻尼器的選型、交叉索、現場監測、自由衰減驗收、錨口彎曲疲勞與阻尼器維護，建立從量測到對策與驗收的完整流程。
summaryEn: Rain–wind vibration is a large-amplitude motion of stay cables that occurs when moderate wind and rain coincide; it was first systematically recorded on Japan’s Meiko-Nishi Bridge in the 1980s and later appeared soon after opening on bridges such as the Pont de Normandie and the Erasmus Bridge. The course builds a full workflow from measurement to remedy and acceptance: the aerodynamics of the upper rivulet, the Scruton number threshold, helical ribs on HDPE ducts, selection of external and internal dampers, cross-ties, field monitoring, free-decay acceptance, bending fatigue at the anchor exit and damper maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」與「史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay" and "The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「上緣水線」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Upper water rivulet” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 乾燥的圓形斜索在一般風中很少大幅振動，因為圓形斷面沒有使振動自我放大的氣動力。下雨時，雨水沿傾斜的索面流下，在下緣與上緣各形成一條水線；上緣水線的位置由重力、表面張力與風的拖曳力共同決定，會隨索的振動在圓周方向來回移動。水線改變了斷面的有效形狀與氣流分離點，使氣動升力隨索的運動而變化，相位若恰好與速度同向，就等於負阻尼，把風的能量持續輸入索中。這種振動多發生在斜索沿風向往下傾斜、風速中等、雨量適中時，雨太大或太小、風太強都可能使水線無法穩定存在。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「上緣水線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dry circular stay rarely vibrates heavily in ordinary wind, because a circular section produces no self-amplifying aerodynamic force. In rain, water running down the inclined surface forms rivulets along the lower and upper sides; the upper rivulet’s position, set by gravity, surface tension and wind drag, oscillates around the circumference as the cable moves. The rivulet changes the effective section shape and flow separation, so lift varies with cable motion; when it is in phase with velocity it acts as negative damping and keeps feeding wind energy into the cable. The vibration typically occurs on stays inclined downward in the wind direction, at moderate wind speed and moderate rainfall; too much or too little rain, or very strong wind, can prevent a stable rivulet. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Upper water rivulet” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：折算風速 U_r = U/(f·D)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Reduced velocity U_r = U/(f·D).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「上緣水線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Upper water rivulet”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay

In rain, water running down the inclined surface forms rivulets along the lower and upper sides; the upper rivulet’s position, set by gravity, surface tension and wind drag, oscillates around the circumference as the cable moves.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay" is correct?
options: 雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。
乾燥的圓形斜索在一般風中很少大幅振動，因為圓形斷面沒有使振動自我放大的氣動力。
斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。
optionsEn: Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration.
A dry circular stay rarely vibrates heavily in ordinary wind, because a circular section produces no self-amplifying aerodynamic force.
Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration.
quiz.explanation: 乾燥的圓形斜索在一般風中很少大幅振動，因為圓形斷面沒有使振動自我放大的氣動力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A dry circular stay rarely vibrates heavily in ordinary wind, because a circular section produces no self-amplifying aerodynamic force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上緣水線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Upper water rivulet” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：折算風速 U_r = U/(f·D)。若 f = 1.2 Hz、D = 0.16 m，風速 U = 12 m/s 時 U_r = 12/(1.2×0.16) = 62.5；若觀測的發生風速範圍為 8 至 15 m/s，對應 U_r 約 42 至 78。以 U_r 表示可把不同索徑與頻率的觀測放在同一張圖比較。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Reduced velocity U_r = U/(f·D). With f = 1.2 Hz and D = 0.16 m, U = 12 m/s gives U_r = 12/(1.2×0.16) = 62.5; an observed onset range of 8 to 15 m/s corresponds to U_r of about 42 to 78. Expressing data as U_r lets cables of different diameters and frequencies be compared on one chart. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風洞人工降雨試驗或現場同步紀錄（索加速度、風速風向、雨量）辨識振動發生的風速、風向與降雨區間，並以攝影確認上緣水線的存在與移動；把結果換成折算風速與相對風向角，與文獻中的發生區間比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify the wind speed, direction and rainfall range of onset by wind-tunnel tests with artificial rain or synchronised field records of cable acceleration, wind and rainfall, confirming the presence and motion of the upper rivulet by video; convert results to reduced velocity and relative yaw angle and compare with onset ranges in the literature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 折算風速 U_r = U/(f·D)。若 f = 1.2 Hz、D = 0.16 m，風速 U = 12 m/s 時 U_r = 12/(1.2×0.16) = 62.5；若觀測的發生風速範圍為 8 至 15 m/s，對應 U_r 約 42 至 78。以 U_r 表示可把不同索徑與頻率的觀測放在同一張圖比較。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Reduced velocity U_r = U/(f·D). With f = 1.2 Hz and D = 0.16 m, U = 12 m/s gives U_r = 12/(1.2×0.16) = 62.5; an observed onset range of 8 to 15 m/s corresponds to U_r of about 42 to 78. Expressing data as U_r lets cables of different diameters and frequencies be compared on one chart. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。
內置阻尼器藏在導管裡，因此不需要檢查或維護。
折算風速 U_r = U/(f·D)。
optionsEn: Dampers work best right at the anchorage, where the stay is steadiest.
Internal dampers are hidden in the guide pipe, so they need no inspection or maintenance.
Reduced velocity U_r = U/(f·D).
quiz.explanation: 折算風速 U_r = U/(f·D)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Reduced velocity U_r = U/(f·D). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上緣水線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Upper water rivulet” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風洞人工降雨試驗或現場同步紀錄（索加速度、風速風向、雨量）辨識振動發生的風速、風向與降雨區間，並以攝影確認上緣水線的存在與移動；把結果換成折算風速與相對風向角，與文獻中的發生區間比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify the wind speed, direction and rainfall range of onset by wind-tunnel tests with artificial rain or synchronised field records of cable acceleration, wind and rainfall, confirming the presence and motion of the upper rivulet by video; convert results to reduced velocity and relative yaw angle and compare with onset ranges in the literature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斜張橋設計階段就要依索的傾角、方位與當地盛行風雨評估雨風振動風險，並在設計報告中列出每組索的對策（表面處理、阻尼、交叉索）與預留空間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At design stage, assess rain–wind risk from each stay’s inclination, orientation and the local prevailing wind and rain, and list in the design report the remedy for each stay group (surface treatment, damping, cross-ties) with space reserved.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Misreading rain–wind vibration as ordinary vortex shedding and fitting only small high-frequency dampers leaves it to return in the next rainstorm; sustained large amplitudes cause bending fatigue at the anchor exit, wear ducts and caps, alarm users and force traffic restrictions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以風洞人工降雨試驗或現場同步紀錄（索加速度、風速風向、雨量）辨識振動發生的風速、風向與降雨區間，並以攝影確認上緣水線的存在與移動；把結果換成折算風速與相對風向角，與文獻中的發生區間比較。
knowledge.textEn: Identify the wind speed, direction and rainfall range of onset by wind-tunnel tests with artificial rain or synchronised field records of cable acceleration, wind and rainfall, confirming the presence and motion of the upper rivulet by video; convert results to reduced velocity and relative yaw angle and compare with onset ranges in the literature.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 斜張橋設計階段就要依索的傾角、方位與當地盛行風雨評估雨風振動風險，並在設計報告中列出每組索的對策（表面處理、阻尼、交叉索）與預留空間。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage, assess rain–wind risk from each stay’s inclination, orientation and the local prevailing wind and rain, and list in the design report the remedy for each stay group (surface treatment, damping, cross-ties) with space reserved.

quiz.question: 要驗證「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay"?
options: 以風洞人工降雨試驗或現場同步紀錄（索加速度、風速風向、雨量）辨識振動發生的風速、風向與降雨區間，並以攝影確認上緣水線的存在與移動。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
阻尼器有出廠試驗報告，就不需要在橋上做衰減試驗。
optionsEn: Identify the wind speed, direction and rainfall range of onset by wind-tunnel tests with artificial rain or synchronised field records of cable acceleration, wind and rainfall, confirming the presence and motion of the upper rivulet by video.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A damper with a factory test report needs no decay test on the bridge.
quiz.explanation: 以風洞人工降雨試驗或現場同步紀錄（索加速度、風速風向、雨量）辨識振動發生的風速、風向與降雨區間，並以攝影確認上緣水線的存在與移動；把結果換成折算風速與相對風向角，與文獻中的發生區間比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify the wind speed, direction and rainfall range of onset by wind-tunnel tests with artificial rain or synchronised field records of cable acceleration, wind and rainfall, confirming the presence and motion of the upper rivulet by video; convert results to reduced velocity and relative yaw angle and compare with onset ranges in the literature. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上緣水線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Upper water rivulet” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Misreading rain–wind vibration as ordinary vortex shedding and fitting only small high-frequency dampers leaves it to return in the next rainstorm; sustained large amplitudes cause bending fatigue at the anchor exit, wear ducts and caps, alarm users and force traffic restrictions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種振動多發生在斜索沿風向往下傾斜、風速中等、雨量適中時，雨太大或太小、風太強都可能使水線無法穩定存在。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The vibration typically occurs on stays inclined downward in the wind direction, at moderate wind speed and moderate rainfall; too much or too little rain, or very strong wind, can prevent a stable rivulet.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。
knowledge.textEn: Misreading rain–wind vibration as ordinary vortex shedding and fitting only small high-frequency dampers leaves it to return in the next rainstorm; sustained large amplitudes cause bending fatigue at the anchor exit, wear ducts and caps, alarm users and force traffic restrictions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。
斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Misreading rain–wind vibration as ordinary vortex shedding and fitting only small high-frequency dampers leaves it to return in the next rainstorm.
Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration.
quiz.explanation: 若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Misreading rain–wind vibration as ordinary vortex shedding and fitting only small high-frequency dampers leaves it to return in the next rainstorm; sustained large amplitudes cause bending fatigue at the anchor exit, wear ducts and caps, alarm users and force traffic restrictions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「史庫頓數」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scruton number” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 史庫頓數 Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) 把索的單位長度質量 m、阻尼比 ζ 與空氣密度 ρ、索徑 D 合成一個無因次數，表示結構消耗能量的能力相對於氣流能輸入的能量。Sc 越大，雨風振動與渦振越不容易發展。長斜索的固有阻尼通常只有千分之一到千分之幾，Sc 往往只有個位數；工程上常被引用的門檻約為 10，表面經過有效處理時可放寬。由於 m 與 D 由結構需要決定，工程師真正能調整的是阻尼比，因此 Sc 準則直接轉化為「需要多少附加阻尼」的設計目標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「史庫頓數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) combines mass per metre m, damping ratio ζ, air density ρ and diameter D into a dimensionless measure of the structure’s ability to dissipate energy relative to what the flow can feed in. The larger Sc, the less likely rain–wind or vortex vibration can develop. Long stays usually have inherent damping of only one to a few thousandths, giving Sc in single figures; a commonly cited threshold is about 10, relaxable where effective surface treatment is used. Since m and D are fixed by structural needs, the variable engineers can really change is damping, so the Sc criterion becomes a target for added damping. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Scruton number” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「史庫頓數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Scruton number”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「史庫頓數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scruton number” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m。固有阻尼 ζ = 0.2% 時 Sc = 60×0.002/0.032 = 3.75；要達到 Sc = 10，需 ζ = 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%，即至少增加約 0.33% 的附加阻尼。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m. Inherent damping ζ = 0.2% gives Sc = 60×0.002/0.032 = 3.75; reaching Sc = 10 needs ζ = 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%, at least about 0.33% of added damping. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以自由衰減試驗量測每組代表性斜索的固有阻尼（未裝阻尼器時），計算 Sc 並與門檻比較；裝阻尼器後再量一次，確認 Sc 達標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure inherent damping of representative stays in each group by free decay before dampers are fitted, compute Sc against the threshold, then measure again after fitting to confirm compliance; cover the several modes most likely to be excited, because one damper gives different damping in different modes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m. Inherent damping ζ = 0.2% gives Sc = 60×0.002/0.032 = 3.75; reaching Sc = 10 needs ζ = 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%, at least about 0.33% of added damping. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input", which statement holds?
options: 取 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m。
交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。
只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。
optionsEn: With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m.
Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation.
An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration.
quiz.explanation: 取 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「史庫頓數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scruton number” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以自由衰減試驗量測每組代表性斜索的固有阻尼（未裝阻尼器時），計算 Sc 並與門檻比較；裝阻尼器後再量一次，確認 Sc 達標。量測要涵蓋最可能被激發的數個模態，因為同一阻尼器在不同模態提供的阻尼不同。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure inherent damping of representative stays in each group by free decay before dampers are fitted, compute Sc against the threshold, then measure again after fitting to confirm compliance; cover the several modes most likely to be excited, because one damper gives different damping in different modes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斜索規格書應以 Sc 或最低對數遞減率表示阻尼要求，並註明適用的模態範圍與量測方法；驗收報告須逐組列出量測的阻尼與計算的 Sc。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The stay specification should express damping requirements as Sc or a minimum logarithmic decrement, state the applicable mode range and test method, and the acceptance report should list measured damping and computed Sc for each group.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以設計假設的固有阻尼（例如 0.5%）計算 Sc 而不量測，實際只有 0.1% 至 0.2% 時，振動仍會發生；阻尼器只針對第一模態最佳化，較高模態的 Sc 可能仍低於門檻。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Computing Sc from an assumed inherent damping such as 0.5% without measurement, when the real value is only 0.1% to 0.2%, leaves vibration to occur; a damper optimised only for mode 1 can leave higher modes below the threshold. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以自由衰減試驗量測每組代表性斜索的固有阻尼（未裝阻尼器時），計算 Sc 並與門檻比較；裝阻尼器後再量一次，確認 Sc 達標。量測要涵蓋最可能被激發的數個模態，因為同一阻尼器在不同模態提供的阻尼不同。
knowledge.textEn: Measure inherent damping of representative stays in each group by free decay before dampers are fitted, compute Sc against the threshold, then measure again after fitting to confirm compliance; cover the several modes most likely to be excited, because one damper gives different damping in different modes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 斜索規格書應以 Sc 或最低對數遞減率表示阻尼要求，並註明適用的模態範圍與量測方法；驗收報告須逐組列出量測的阻尼與計算的 Sc。
knowledge.textEn: The stay specification should express damping requirements as Sc or a minimum logarithmic decrement, state the applicable mode range and test method, and the acceptance report should list measured damping and computed Sc for each group.

quiz.question: 要驗證「史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

quiz.explanationEn: Measure inherent damping of representative stays in each group by free decay before dampers are fitted, compute Sc against the threshold, then measure again after fitting to confirm compliance; cover the several modes most likely to be excited, because one damper gives different damping in different modes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「史庫頓數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 若以設計假設的固有阻尼（例如 0.5%）計算 Sc 而不量測，實際只有 0.1% 至 0.2% 時，振動仍會發生；阻尼器只針對第一模態最佳化，較高模態的 Sc 可能仍低於門檻。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於 m 與 D 由結構需要決定，工程師真正能調整的是阻尼比，因此 Sc 準則直接轉化為「需要多少附加阻尼」的設計目標。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
套管表面處理越粗糙，抑振效果越好且沒有副作用。
若以設計假設的固有阻尼（例如 0.5%）計算 Sc 而不量測，實際只有 0.1% 至 0.2% 時，振動仍會發生。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects.
Computing Sc from an assumed inherent damping such as 0.5% without measurement, when the real value is only 0.1% to 0.2%, leaves vibration to occur.
quiz.explanation: 若以設計假設的固有阻尼（例如 0.5%）計算 Sc 而不量測，實際只有 0.1% 至 0.2% 時，振動仍會發生；阻尼器只針對第一模態最佳化，較高模態的 Sc 可能仍低於門檻。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Computing Sc from an assumed inherent damping such as 0.5% without measurement, when the real value is only 0.1% to 0.2%, leaves vibration to occur; a damper optimised only for mode 1 can leave higher modes below the threshold. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
